analysis:
Both units are BASE text excerpts of docs/reference/protocol-messages.md (lines 579-1229). The patch excerpt shows only documentation changes: a date bump and a new 'Add-on hold busy fields' section (head lines 171-195), which adds optional busy_reason, busy_since_ms and busy_addon fields to register and heartbeat, plus small edits near head lines 284, 383 and 1445. The patch excerpt is truncated and the added head text is not visible in the supplied units. I therefore could not examine the full head text or cite any head line. The base text itself is unchanged documentation of existing behavior.

Security-relevant observations to carry forward:
- The new busy fields are provider-authored, so they are untrusted under ADV-001 (TB-002). A malicious provider could claim a hold to go draining, which excludes it from routing. That is self-inflicted and low impact. The reverse matters more: the provider could omit the busy fields and still serve. The document says the hold reuses status=draining, and no coordinator-side authorization depends on these fields.
- busy_addon is a free-form string (a code-signing identifier). The coordinator must bound its length and sanitize it before logging or display, to avoid log injection and unbounded storage (TB-002 and T-058 style linkage). The bounds are not visible in the supplied evidence, so this is an unverified contract.
- The hold explicitly avoids provider_drain. It returns on the same connection with the next idle or serving heartbeat, so the barrier and fence semantics in the base text (the models_replace drain checks and T-053 stale-authorization concerns) should be verified as not weakened. In particular, a reconnect or resume after a hold must not bypass App Attest serving authorization (TB-011, A-016). Registering with busy fields must not grant authorization.
- Pending-reservation and service_reservation_released semantics during a hold are not visible.

No concrete regression can be established from the visible lines. Deeper review of the full head text, including the addon-hold architecture doc, is warranted.
